text: The bench empowers reagents and writes songs. Echo refining stays on the dedicated stations, which cost much less Pulse.
Empowering spends 16 Pulse. A sheet takes 3 to 7 empowered reagents, paper, and one mark of Ritual Chalk.

pages.title: Singing
text: Keep a Reagent Pouch on your hotbar. Reagents you pick up go into it.
Open the bench within 8 blocks of a Resonance Totem. Empower turns one raw reagent into an empowered one for 16 Pulse.

Seat paper and Ritual Chalk. Choose 3 to 7 empowered reagents, in order: click a reagent to select it, then press **Add** (or click it twice). **Shift-click** a reagent to empower one. The first picks the shape. The totem picks the voice.

Fletch, Take and Anoint work on the reagent you selected. A written **song sheet** can be sung once straight from your hand, or bound into a songbook: seat the book, leave the sheet in the output and press **Write** with nothing in the sequence.

pages.title: What it costs
text: Writing spends those reagents, the paper and one chalk mark, plus 12 Pulse for each reagent on the sheet.
A rank makes the Pulse cheaper.
The first songbook holds 1 page of 3 reagents. The bound book holds 3 pages, up to 5. The chorus book holds 5 pages, up to 7.
Right-click a held book to sing. Crouch and right-click to turn the page. A cell in the book pays.
One empowered reagent fletches four verse arrows. The Pulse Bow fires them.

pages.title: Anointing a weapon
text: The bench has a fifth seat now, beside the output: a **weapon slot**. Put a sword, an axe, a trident, a mace or any Spiritgear weapon in it, click a reagent in the list to select it and press **Anoint**.

It spends **4 empowered reagents** of that kind and **32 Pulse**, and the weapon keeps the reagent's power until you anoint it with something else. The whole story is on the [Anointing](anointing) page.

steps.caption: A Song Bench with a generator in range.
An Earth totem in range can be the voice of the sheet.
Add a Fire totem and the bench can sing in either voice.

pages.title: On the lattice
text: A redstone signal pauses the bench. The Lattice Conductor fills totem buffers. It does not move items through this bench.
Hold the Pulse Bow and draw. A plain bolt spends 6 Pulse. A verse arrow on a full draw spends 12.
